essence: One should say the word Mahishmati while addressing Kartavirya Arjuna.
One should say the word addressed to the consecrated one after the thousand-sacrifice word.
One should then pronounce 'hum' and 'phat' after addressing the jewel of Anasuya's womb.
One should utter 'destroy' as a pair, and likewise 'fell' and 'slay'.
The utterance should be made with this excellent lamp facing west.
